narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Recurrence of #4398 after that issue closed.

v0.118.1 tag `v0.118.1` fired npm-publish.yml run 34799018228 (job 103837718228, 2026-09-14T02:23Z). All four publish steps succeeded:

- Publish @deftai/directive-types
- Publish @deftai/directive-core
- Publish @deftai/directive-content
- Publish @deftai/directive

Then step "Post-publish two-pass fixture (#4271)" concluded failure (~5.5 min, 02:23:45Z-02:29:07Z). The workflow conclusion is failure. Phase 7 `npm view` of all four `@<pkg>@0.118.1` versions succeeded. GitHub release is public. Packages shipped; the job is still red.

#4398 bound remedy (closed 2026-09-13): retry the tag-bound registry install with real backoff; after the bound, warn-only so npm-publish.yml stays green; publish-step failure still fails. That warn-only job-exit did not hold on this cut.

## Expected

After four successful `npm publish --provenance` steps, a still-propagating registry install does not fail npm-publish.yml. Warn-only after the retry bound.

## Actual

Fixture step fails the job. Operators treat a red npm-publish run as "packages missing" and remint / wait, even when registry truth is already 0.118.1.

## Acceptance

- Reproduce against the v0.118.1 job (four green publishes, fixture red, registry has all four versions).
- After four green publishes, fixture retry-then-warn does not set workflow conclusion=failure.
- Publish-step failure still fails the job.
- Keep tag-bind and `--ignore-scripts`. Do not fold Phase 7 / `pollWorkspacePackages` (#4267).
- CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`.
- Do not unpublish. Do not skip `--provenance`.

## Out of scope

- Recutting v0.118.1 packages.
- Making `npm view` the pass (forbidden by #4398).

## Origin

v0.118.1 cut, 2026-09-14. Recurrence of #4398. Refs #4271, #4265, #4267.

## Verdict

The named target does not survive. Four green publishes plus a red npm-publish.yml run is real. The failing step was not a still-propagating registry install. #4398 retry-then-warn already held on this cut. Binding #4507 as a recurrence of that warn-only job-exit would miss the defect that actually painted the run red.

## 1. Named target misattributes the v0.118.1 red — blocks-the-design

Evidence.

- Tag v0.118.1 SHA af5bed078345f2b971deb61f91622bd1bb392847 contains f55598e42 (fix(release): retry then warn post-publish npm install (#4398)). CHANGELOG [0.118.0] already records warn-only after the 8-minute bound.
- Run 34799018228 / job 103837718228: four publish steps success; step "Post-publish two-pass fixture (#4271)" failure, 02:23:45Z-02:29:07Z (~5.5 min). Workflow conclusion=failure. .github/workflows/npm-publish.yml at dest SHA has no continue-on-error on that step.
- Job log terminal reason is not ETARGET / "No matching version found" / two-pass closure deferred. It is Pass 2 directive update failed (exit 1) with update_state: "migration-required" and remediation pointing at UPGRADING.md frozen pre-v0.20 (#2068). That path is only reachable after runTagBoundRegistryInstall returns ok and not deferred (npm-ops.ts runPostPublishTwoPassFixture: install, then assertTagBoundDirectiveVersions, then runPass2UpdateFromInstalledCli).
- Wall clock 5.5 min is under POST_PUBLISH_INSTALL_RETRY_BOUND_MS (8 min). Bound exhaustion would have printed the deferred WARN and postPublishTwoPassCliStatus exit 0.
- Re-check at dest SHA: packages/core/src/release-e2e/npm-ops-4398.test.ts 10/10 pass, including "warns after the bound instead of failing a still-propagating registry" mapping to exitCode 0 on stderr.

Failure mode. The issue Expected/Acceptance keep "fixture retry-then-warn does not set conclusion=failure" as the remedy. That contract already shipped and fired past install on this cut. An implementer following the body would either no-op or widen warn-only until Pass 2 failures also exit 0.

Disposition consequence. Do not bind the named target. Recut the premise to the measured Pass 2 refusal. Keep #4398 propagation classifier and bound as already-holding. Keep publish-step failure fail-closed. Do not fold Phase 7 / pollWorkspacePackages (#4267). Do not make npm view the pass.

## 2. Actual hole is the fixture seed vs detectPreCutover — sharpens-framing

Evidence.

- seedInitializedPass1Consumer writes xbrief/{PROJECT-DEFINITION,specification,plan}.xbrief.json, a stub AGENTS.md managed section, and .deft/core/main.md. It does not create lifecycle folders proposed, pending, active, completed, cancelled.
- detectPreCutover (packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/precutover.ts) treats an xbrief/ tree missing those folders as pre-cutover. classify maps that to preCutoverArtifacts. plan() Row 1 returns mode migrate. updateStateFromPlan maps that to migration-required. emitMigrationRequired substitutes command ?? "directive init" — matching the job JSON (update_state migration-required, next_action.command directive init, frozen-bridge remediation).
- Inventory, do not invent: missingLifecycleFolders, classifyUpdateState, isPass2CommitPath, and #4398 isRegistryPropagationFailure already partition this. Pass 2 hard-fail on non-propagation is intentional (if (!updateOk) return [false, updateReason]). Unit tests stub spawnText so live directive update never classifies the seed (npm-ops.test.ts "live path runs installed directive update").

Failure mode. A later cut that publishes cleanly will keep going red on the fixture's own consumer, and operators will again read that as missing packages. Widening warn-only to any fixture failure after four green publishes deletes the #4271 two-pass gate #4398 explicitly kept (deferred, not deleted).

Disposition consequence. Next-build contract is: seed a consumer that classifyUpdateState does not call migration-required (lifecycle folders at minimum; enough current footprint that Pass 2 directive update can run), then keep Pass 2 fail-closed. Lock that with classify/detectPreCutover against the seed, not another backoff constant.

## 3. Stop 1 warrant has no operative pain list — sharpens-framing

Evidence. Ceiling comment 5664447410 is design-critique warranted, because ... with mechanism-shaped: true and the named refutation-target. It has no closed-form pain list (P plus digits).

Failure mode. Bind path 1/2 fails closed as missing-pain even after an all-accept map. Critic headings cannot cover that denominator.

Disposition consequence. Parent amends the warrant (or a superseding Stop 1) with an operative pain list before any completed-arc record. Suggested split: P1 operator-visible red after four green publishes (true); named registry-lag mechanism (does-not-relieve / recut). Do not treat the because-clause English as the list.

## 4. Live Pass 2 is untested against the real CLI — footnote

npm-ops-4398.test.ts and the #4271 live-path test inject spawn success. They lock retry/warn vs E401 and tag-bind. They do not lock that the seeded consumer is a current/updated install. That is why #4398 could close green in CI and still leave the first post-merge tag red.

## Road not taken

Widening fixture warn-only or adding workflow continue-on-error after any post-publish fixture failure. Steelman: the operator pain is identical to #4398 — red npm-publish, packages already on the registry, remint/wait. Flip: the job log would have to show a propagation marker or the deferred WARN with exit 1. It shows Pass 2 migration-required instead. Coarse warn-only would hide a just-published CLI refusing its own two-pass consumer.

Injection / swarm lens: not triggered (no authority, envelope, identity, concurrency, worktree, or shared-state change).
